task_completion.description: Create the 'Museums' vertex class extending 'Attractions' with the specified properties.
task_completion.visual_evidence: SQL command or GUI interaction showing 'CREATE CLASS Museums EXTENDS Attractions' and property definitions (Name, Collection, FreeEntry, AnnualVisitors, City, Country).

task_completion.description: Insert the five specified museum records into the 'Museums' class.
task_completion.visual_evidence: SQL 'INSERT' commands or a data grid showing the five museums (Louvre, British Museum, Met, Uffizi, Rijksmuseum) with their respective data.

task_completion.description: Add the 'Category' property to the parent 'Attractions' class.
task_completion.visual_evidence: SQL command 'CREATE PROPERTY Attractions.Category STRING' or schema view showing the new property in the parent class.

task_completion.description: Update all records in the 'Museums' class to set 'Category' to 'museum'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: SQL command 'UPDATE Museums SET Category = "museum"' and a confirmation message of 5 records updated.

task_completion.description: Execute the polymorphic query to select Name, Category, and @class from Attractions.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Query results table showing columns for Name, Category, and @class, where @class displays 'Museums' for the new records.

task_completion.description: Export the query results to the specified file path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal command (e.g., 'cat') or text editor showing the content of '/home/ga/attraction_hierarchy_report.txt' containing the museum data.

integrity.description: Verify the agent interacted with OrientDB and not just a text file.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the OrientDB Studio (web UI) or the 'console.sh' interactive terminal session.

integrity.description: Ensure the report file was generated via database export/redirection, not manually typed.
integrity.visual_evidence: Command history showing a redirect ('>') or an export command from the database client to the file path.

integrity.description: Check that 'Museums' was actually created as a subclass.
integrity.visual_evidence: Schema view or 'INFO CLASS Museums' output showing 'Super classes: [Attractions]'.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires specific values: Louvre Museum (9600000 visitors, FreeEntry: false), British Museum (5800000 visitors, FreeEntry: true), Metropolitan Museum of Art (6500000 visitors, FreeEntry: false), Uffizi Gallery (4400000 visitors, FreeEntry: false), and Rijksmuseum (2700000 visitors, FreeEntry: false). The final report must be at /home/ga/attraction_hierarchy_report.txt and must include the '@class' column, which proves polymorphism by showing 'Museums' records appearing in an 'Attractions' query.
